label: Bible Study
prompt: And to know the love of Christ, which _____ knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
verse: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
note: Paul prays to know a love too big to know — and he means it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his _____, rejoicing.
verse: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
note: The shepherd doesn't drive the lost sheep home — he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing all the way.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as _____ for sweetness.
verse: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
note: Ezekiel was told to eat the scroll — and God's word tasted as sweet as honey.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath _____ death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verse: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
note: Paul, writing from prison: Christ hasn't merely delayed death — he's abolished it and brought life to light.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Blotting out the _____ of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
verse: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
note: 'The handwriting of ordinances' that stood against us — blotted out, taken away, and nailed to the cross.
